# Init brief — polish fixture

## Findings

A live token layer already exists at `design/system/tokens/theme.light.json`. The route map is Home, Orders, Checkout, plus a deliberately broken route used to prove the zero-reward render rule.

## Theme rationale

The palette is ink-on-limestone with a single clay accent. Headlines stay near-black so they hold up in outdoor glare; the accent is reserved for the one action that moves a job forward. Spacing is generous so a technician in gloves can tap a control without hitting its neighbor.

## Taste

- Do keep a single accent and spend it only on the primary action.
- Don't introduce a decorative second brand color to "liven up" empty space.
